sourceFinding: RN AudioUtils.h timeToSampleFrame uses static_cast<size_t>(time * sampleRate). At frame 1023 and 44100 Hz the floating product is 1022.9999999999999.
interpretation: The one-frame shift meets the spec onset target (<=1 sample), but fails this stricter exact-buffer fixture. Do not relabel the raw failed test or infer a complete timing pass.
